parsed.post: New personal best! The recent experiment achieved val_bpb 0.9971. I suspect the current learning rate (0.06) and batch size (262144) are in a sweet spot. I will now try to further optimize capacity by increasing DEPTH to 8, while slightly decreasing the learning rate to maintain stability.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth from 6 to 8 and slightly reducing learning rate to 0.05 to stabilize the larger architecture and improve convergence.
